turns.q: Where can I find your full shipping policy?
turns.replyTail:
07:43 PM

Hi! Our shipping policy includes free U.S. shipping on orders over $150, and orders under $150 have a flat shipping rate of $9.95. Please also allow 3 to 4 business days for processing, and we do not offer Saturday delivery. Orders placed after 10 AM PST may not ship until the following 3 to 4 business days, and orders placed on Saturday or Sunday are processed during the week. Shipments can also be delayed due to weather or other unavoidable circumstances. Hope that helps 🙂
